text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, my lovely signorina! I 
celebrate your birth from the bottom of my 
heart!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "present" that was "GIVU"... Did 
Victoire Pisa "like" it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! The cameo brooch and the 
star lamp were both absolutely lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, you even gave me such 
a beautiful bouquet...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Just like the two of you, it's 
such a gentle, warm, and soothing scent... 
I'm truly happy. From the bottom of my 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, signorina! Your smile was just 
so amabile, so amoroso—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Our hearts are burning with such fierce 
passione...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Neo Universe and the others' 
hearts are "cozy" and "warm"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The kindness of you both— it has 
truly flowed straight into my heart. Thank 
you so, so very much.
